```{ojs}
lyricData = {
const lyricsCsv = await d3.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-08-25/country_lyrics.csv",
  {proxy: true}
);

const stopwords = new Set(`
a about above after again against all am an and any are aren't as at be because been before being below between both but by
can't cannot could couldn't did didn't do does doesn't doing don't down during each few for from further had hadn't has hasn't
have haven't having he he'd he'll he's her here here's hers herself him himself his how how's i i'd i'll i'm i've if in into is
isn't it it's its itself let's me more most mustn't my myself no nor not of off on once only or other ought our ours ourselves
out over own same shan't she she'd she'll she's should shouldn't so some such than that that's the their theirs them themselves
then there there's these they they'd they'll they're they've this those through to too under until up very was wasn't we we'd
we'll we're we've were weren't what what's when when's where where's which while who who's whom why why's with won't would
wouldn't you you'd you'll you're you've your yours yourself yourselves
im youre youll ill hes shes theyre weve ive dont didnt cant wont isnt arent wasnt werent doesnt couldnt shouldnt wouldnt
oh yeah hey na la ooh whoa ah gonna wanna gotta cause ain't ain aint just like got get one two would could well still even
never know knew knows make made take took come came go went say said see saw look looked back down around
can every little right way good now let want long
`.trim().split(/\s+/));

function tokenize(text) {
  return (text || "")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[’']/g, "'")
    .match(/[a-z']+/g) || [];
}

const songs = lyricsCsv.map(row => {
  const allTokens = tokenize(row.lyrics).map(word => word.replace(/^'+|'+$/g, ""));
  const tokens = allTokens.filter(word => word.length >= 3 && !stopwords.has(word));
  return {
    song: row.song,
    artist: row.artist,
    year: +row.entered_top_30_in,
    lyrics: row.lyrics || "",
    tokens,
    wordCount: allTokens.filter(Boolean).length
  };
});

const songYears = Array.from(new Set(songs.map(d => d.year))).sort(d3.ascending);
const wordCounts = d3.rollups(
  songs.flatMap(song => song.tokens),
  values => values.length,
  word => word
)
  .map(([word, count]) => ({word, count}))
  .sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a.count, b.count));

const rankedWords = wordCounts.slice(0, 10);
const wordPalette = [
  "#dbc0e8", "#a3c1e2", "#f7e289", "#fbb28b", "#f76f5a",
  "#a9b49a", "#ea5e86", "#47b5a8", "#f9a2c5", "#b79a65"
];
const colorMap = new Map(rankedWords.map((d, index) => [d.word, wordPalette[index]]));
const wordStats = rankedWords
  .map(d => {
    const songCount = songs.filter(song => song.tokens.includes(d.word)).length;
    return {...d, songCount, share: songCount / songs.length};
  })
  .sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a.songCount, b.songCount) || d3.descending(a.count, b.count));
const wordChoices = wordStats.map(d => d.word);
const neutralColor = "#737986";
const neutralStroke = "#aeb4c0";

return {lyricsCsv, songs, songYears, wordChoices, wordStats, colorMap, neutralColor, neutralStroke};
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectedWord = (() => {
  const {wordStats, colorMap} = lyricData;
  const picker = document.createElement("fieldset");
  picker.className = "tt34-picker";
  picker.setAttribute("aria-label", "Highlight a lyric word");
  picker.value = wordStats[0].word;

  wordStats.forEach(({word, share}) => {
    const label = document.createElement("label");
    label.className = "tt34-choice";
    label.style.setProperty("--word-color", colorMap.get(word));

    const input = document.createElement("input");
    input.type = "radio";
    input.name = "tt34-word";
    input.value = word;
    input.checked = word === picker.value;
    input.setAttribute("aria-label", `${word}, ${d3.format(".0%")(share)} of songs`);

    const record = document.createElement("span");
    record.className = "tt34-selector-record";

    const percentage = document.createElement("span");
    percentage.className = "tt34-selector-percent";
    percentage.textContent = d3.format(".0%")(share);
    record.appendChild(percentage);

    const text = document.createElement("span");
    text.className = "tt34-selector-word";
    text.textContent = word;
    label.append(input, record, text);
    picker.appendChild(label);
  });

  picker.addEventListener("change", event => {
    picker.value = event.target.value;
    picker.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
  });

  return picker;
})()
```

```{ojs}
bubbleLayout = {
const {songs, songYears} = lyricData;
const chartWidth = 1100;
const chartHeight = 620;
const chartMargin = {top: 40, right: 30, bottom: 60, left: 30};
const yearX = d3.scalePoint(
  songYears,
  [chartMargin.left + 50, chartWidth - chartMargin.right - 50]
).padding(0.6);
const radius = d3.scaleSqrt(d3.extent(songs, d => d.wordCount), [4.5, 12]);

const bubbleNodes = songs.map((song, index) => ({
  ...song,
  targetX: yearX(song.year),
  x: yearX(song.year) + ((index % 7) - 3) * 1.5,
  y: chartHeight / 2 + ((index % 11) - 5) * 1.5,
  r: radius(song.wordCount)
}));

const simulation = d3.forceSimulation(bubbleNodes)
  .force("x", d3.forceX(d => d.targetX).strength(0.09))
  .force("y", d3.forceY(chartHeight / 2).strength(0.05))
  .force("collide", d3.forceCollide(d => d.r + 1.4).strength(0.95))
  .stop();

for (let index = 0; index < 500; index += 1) simulation.tick();

for (const node of bubbleNodes) {
  node.y = Math.max(
    chartMargin.top + node.r,
    Math.min(chartHeight - chartMargin.bottom + 10 - node.r, node.y)
  );
}

return {chartWidth, chartHeight, chartMargin, yearX, bubbleNodes};
}
```

```{ojs}
chartCard = {
const {songYears, colorMap, neutralColor, neutralStroke} = lyricData;
const {chartWidth, chartHeight, chartMargin, yearX, bubbleNodes} = bubbleLayout;

function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value)
    .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
    .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
    .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
    .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
}

function bubbleField(nodes, selectedWord, selectedColor) {
  const data = nodes
    .map(node => {
      const occurrences = node.tokens.filter(word => word === selectedWord).length;
      return {...node, occurrences, isMatch: occurrences > 0};
    })
    .sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.isMatch, b.isMatch));

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, chartWidth, chartHeight])
    .attr("role", "img")
    .attr(
      "aria-label",
      `A beeswarm of ${data.length} country songs by year. Colored vinyl records contain the word ${selectedWord}.`
    )
    .attr("font-family", "'Avenir Next',Avenir,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif")
    .style("display", "block");

  svg.append("rect")
    .attr("width", chartWidth)
    .attr("height", chartHeight)
    .attr("rx", 18)
    .attr("fill", "#252d45");

  const plot = svg.append("g");
  plot.selectAll("line.tt34-grid")
    .data(songYears)
    .join("line")
    .attr("class", "tt34-grid")
    .attr("x1", yearX)
    .attr("x2", yearX)
    .attr("y1", chartMargin.top - 6)
    .attr("y2", chartHeight - chartMargin.bottom + 4)
    .attr("stroke", "#a3c1e2")
    .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.2);

  const bubbles = plot.selectAll("g.tt34-record")
    .data(data)
    .join("g")
    .attr("class", "tt34-record")
    .attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.x},${d.y})`)
    .attr("role", "img")
    .attr("aria-label", d => `${d.song} by ${d.artist}, ${d.year}`)
    .attr("tabindex", 0)
    .style("cursor", "pointer");

  bubbles.append("circle")
    .attr("class", "tt34-record-edge")
    .attr("r", d => d.r)
    .attr("fill", d => d.isMatch ? selectedColor : neutralColor)
    .attr("fill-opacity", d => d.isMatch ? 0.97 : 0.82)
    .attr("stroke", d => d.isMatch ? d3.color(selectedColor).brighter(0.45).formatHex() : neutralStroke)
    .attr("stroke-width", d => d.isMatch ? 0.9 : 0.65)
    .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.78);

  bubbles.append("circle")
    .attr("r", d => d.r * 0.73)
    .attr("fill", "none")
    .attr("stroke", d => d.isMatch ? "#252d45" : "#4f5562")
    .attr("stroke-width", d => Math.max(0.35, d.r * 0.055))
    .attr("stroke-opacity", d => d.isMatch ? 0.3 : 0.2);

  bubbles.append("circle")
    .attr("r", d => d.r * 0.49)
    .attr("fill", "none")
    .attr("stroke", d => d.isMatch ? "#ffffff" : "#c7cbd3")
    .attr("stroke-width", d => Math.max(0.3, d.r * 0.045))
    .attr("stroke-opacity", d => d.isMatch ? 0.24 : 0.2);

  bubbles.append("circle")
    .attr("r", d => Math.max(1.35, d.r * 0.27))
    .attr("fill", d => d.isMatch ? "#252d45" : "#555b68")
    .attr("stroke", d => d.isMatch ? selectedColor : "#aeb4c0")
    .attr("stroke-width", 0.35);

  bubbles.append("circle")
    .attr("r", d => Math.max(0.38, d.r * 0.065))
    .attr("fill", d => d.isMatch ? "#f7e289" : "#d5d8df");

  plot.selectAll("text.tt34-year")
    .data(songYears)
    .join("text")
    .attr("class", "tt34-year")
    .attr("x", yearX)
    .attr("y", chartHeight - chartMargin.bottom + 28)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("fill", "#f7f2ec")
    .attr("font-size", 15)
    .attr("font-weight", 600)
    .style("font-variant", "small-caps")
    .style("letter-spacing", "0.5px")
    .text(year => year);

  const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
  wrapper.style.position = "relative";
  wrapper.style.width = "100%";
  wrapper.style.lineHeight = "0";
  wrapper.appendChild(svg.node());

  const tip = document.createElement("div");
  Object.assign(tip.style, {
    position: "absolute",
    pointerEvents: "none",
    opacity: "0",
    transition: "opacity 120ms ease",
    background: "#303850",
    border: `1px solid ${selectedColor}cc`,
    borderRadius: "12px",
    padding: "10px 12px",
    boxShadow: "0 9px 24px rgba(8, 10, 18, 0.42)",
    fontFamily: "'Avenir Next',Avenir,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif",
    fontSize: "13px",
    lineHeight: "1.35",
    color: "#f7f2ec",
    width: "min(230px, 70vw)",
    zIndex: "5"
  });
  wrapper.appendChild(tip);

  function tooltipMarkup(d) {
    const wordLine = d.isMatch
      ? `<strong style="color:${selectedTextColor}">${escapeHtml(selectedWord)}</strong> appears ${d.occurrences} ${d.occurrences === 1 ? "time" : "times"}`
      : `<strong style="color:${selectedTextColor}">${escapeHtml(selectedWord)}</strong> does not appear`;
    return `<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:2px">${escapeHtml(d.song)}</div>
      <div style="color:#f7f2ec;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:7px">${escapeHtml(d.artist)} · ${d.year}</div>
      <div>${wordLine}</div>
      <div style="color:#f7f2ec;font-size:11.5px;margin-top:3px">${d3.format(",")(d.wordCount)} lyric words</div>`;
  }

  function positionTooltip(event) {
    const bounds = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = event.clientX - bounds.left;
    const y = event.clientY - bounds.top;
    const tooltipWidth = Math.min(230, bounds.width * 0.7);
    tip.style.left = `${x > bounds.width - tooltipWidth - 24 ? x - tooltipWidth - 16 : x + 14}px`;
    tip.style.top = `${Math.max(4, y - 52)}px`;
  }

  function showTooltip(event, d) {
    const record = d3.select(event.currentTarget).raise();
    record.select(".tt34-record-edge").attr("stroke-width", 2).attr("stroke-opacity", 1);
    tip.innerHTML = tooltipMarkup(d);
    tip.style.opacity = "1";
    if (Number.isFinite(event.clientX)) positionTooltip(event);
  }

  function hideTooltip(event, d) {
    d3.select(event.currentTarget).select(".tt34-record-edge")
      .attr("stroke-width", d.isMatch ? 1 : 0.7)
      .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.78);
    tip.style.opacity = "0";
  }

  bubbles
    .on("pointerenter", showTooltip)
    .on("pointermove", positionTooltip)
    .on("pointerleave", hideTooltip)
    .on("focus", function(event, d) {
      const bounds = this.getBoundingClientRect();
      showTooltip({
        currentTarget: this,
        clientX: bounds.left + bounds.width / 2,
        clientY: bounds.top + bounds.height / 2
      }, d);
    })
    .on("blur", hideTooltip);

  return {
    node: wrapper,
    total: data.length,
    matches: data.filter(d => d.isMatch).length
  };
}

const selectedColor = colorMap.get(selectedWord);
const selectedTextColor = selectedColor;
const bubbleChart = bubbleField(bubbleNodes, selectedWord, selectedColor);
const percentMatch = d3.format(".0%")(bubbleChart.matches / bubbleChart.total);

const bubbleCard = html`<section class="tt34-card" style="border-color:${selectedColor}88">
  <h2>A country music hit parade of words</h2>
  <p class="tt34-deck">
    <strong style="color:${selectedTextColor}">${selectedWord}</strong> appears in
    ${d3.format(",")(bubbleChart.matches)} of ${d3.format(",")(bubbleChart.total)} songs (${percentMatch}).
    Each little record is one Top 30 hit, gathered by entry year and sized by lyric length.
  </p>
  <div class="tt34-chart">${viewof selectedWord}${bubbleChart.node}</div>
  <div class="tt34-source">
    Source: Country Music Lyrics TdidyTuesday week 34 2026 · Graphic: Deepali Kank
  </div>
</section>`;

return bubbleCard;
}
```
